scripts.infra:dns: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infra/dns.yml --stack-name drestin-dns --region us-east-1
scripts.infra:site: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infra/site.yml --stack-name drestin-site-prod --region us-east-1
scripts.deploy:local: node scripts/check-media.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.infra:cicd: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infra/cicd.yml --stack-name drestin-cicd --region us-east-1 --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
